title: Nitrogen molecule magnetism and bond order
hints: Check the final sigma occupancy and each filled pi orbital.
solution: Fill $\sigma_{2s}^2,\sigma^*_{2s}{}^2,\pi_{2p}^4,\sigma_{2p}^2$. The order is $(8-2)/2=3$ and all individual orbitals have paired electrons.
statement:
What does the course MO diagram predict for neutral $\ce{N2}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: Eight bonding and two antibonding valence electrons are all paired.
The filled bonding 2p levels are paired.
This misses two bonding electrons in σ₂p.
This is consistent with losing one bonding electron to make N₂⁺.
